Project add makes any directory a project of its own (a deeper one than
a root's children; a root's own children are projects already), or
changes an existing project's depth.

Usage:
  agent index project [flags]
  agent index project [command]

Examples:
  agent index project add ~/dev/big/vendor/lib --depth files

Available Commands:
  add         Add a directory as a project, or set a project's depth

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for project

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent index project [command] --help" for more information about a command.
